title: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence
paper_type_zh: 前沿智能体模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计可执行工作区、智能体轨迹和长程 RL 披露边界的读者
one_line: MiniMax-M2 reports executable-workspace trajectories and artifact-aligned rewards under Forge agent RL, but not the task corpus, validator implementation, or replayable trajectory ledger.
MiniMax-M2 报告了由可执行工作区、工件对齐奖励和 Forge 驱动的长程智能体 RL，但未公开任务、环境、奖励实现或轨迹台账。
why: It is a clear case where environmental reward language is valuable evidence but not a substitute for auditable task, trajectory, and verifier artifacts.
inclusion_reason: A 2026 agentic frontier report with unusually concrete environment/reward language that still lacks the trajectory and validator ledger needed for reproducibility.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The MiniMax-M2 report targets long-horizon agent training rather than isolated chat completion. Coding, web research, spreadsheet work, slide production, and other knowledge-work tasks can span many model calls, tool observations, mutable artifacts, and context-management operations. A useful training object must therefore include a runnable workspace, an action/observation trajectory, and an acceptance signal tied to the final artifact or environment state.

The report’s data contribution is a family of agent-driven pipelines that construct such objects for software engineering, application development, terminal work, open-web research, office artifacts, finance, spreadsheets, slides, reasoning, conversation, and role-play. The central audit question is whether task construction and reward design preserve objective evidence through these long trajectories. Counts, full schemas, source manifests, teacher identities, and released trajectory artifacts remain undisclosed.

MiniMax-M2 报告面向的是长程智能体训练，而不是孤立的对话补全。代码开发、网页研究、电子表格、幻灯片和其他知识工作可能跨越许多次模型调用、工具观察、可变产物及上下文管理操作。因此，有效训练对象需要同时包含可运行工作区、动作—观察轨迹，以及与最终产物或环境状态对齐的验收信号。

报告的数据贡献是一组智能体驱动流水线，用于构建软件工程、应用开发、终端操作、开放网页研究、办公产物、金融、电子表格、幻灯片、推理、通用对话和角色扮演数据。核心审计问题是：在长轨迹中，任务构造与奖励设计能否持续保留客观证据。各数据集规模、完整模式、来源清单、教师身份和可下载轨迹仍未披露。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core idea is “workspace plus artifact-aligned reward.” Tasks are instantiated in executable environments, trajectories are generated or distilled under varied agent scaffolds, and acceptance is chosen for the artifact type rather than delegated to one universal judge. Repository repair uses tests; terminal tasks use generated Docker environments and scripts; search requires retrieved evidence; spreadsheets are recalculated and compared at value level; and slides combine execution, functional, layout, and rendered-image checks.

For optimization, the model is the policy and everything beyond its generation interface—including tools, memory, context rewriting, sub-agent control, and artifacts—is the environment. Forge records completion/observation pairs but propagates credit over the full episode. This permits white-box and API-only agent scaffolds to share a training system while keeping the environment boundary explicit.

核心思想是“工作区加产物对齐奖励”。任务在可执行环境中实例化，轨迹在不同智能体脚手架下生成或蒸馏，验收方式依据产物类型选择，而不是交给单一通用评审模型。仓库修复使用测试；终端任务使用生成的 Docker 环境与脚本；网页研究要求检索证据；电子表格重新计算并逐值比较；幻灯片则组合执行、功能、版式与渲染图像检查。

优化时，模型被视为策略，其生成接口之外的一切——工具、记忆、上下文改写、子智能体控制和产物——都属于环境。Forge 记录每次补全与观察对，但在完整 episode 上传播信用。由此，白盒和仅 API 可见的智能体脚手架可以共享训练系统，同时保持环境边界清晰。

title: Method
方法
html:
The SWE pipeline starts from merged pull requests and linked issues in public, permissively licensed GitHub repositories. Rule filters require relevant tests; agents iteratively build multi-language Docker environments; PRs are tagged by task type; and rewards are specialized as fail-to-pass/pass-to-pass tests, new feature tests, or performance checks. Model-based validation repairs underspecified problem statements. Augmentations include bug injection, commit merging, SWE-Test inversion, and approximately verifiable code-review tasks. Each retained instance is described as a problem statement, test-based reward, and runnable Docker environment.

AppDev uses expert-authored meta-queries and rubrics, then Agent-as-a-Verifier rejection sampling in sandboxes over execution, interaction, and aesthetics. Terminal-Gym filters community threads for scriptable, Linux/Docker-compatible, verifiable tasks; rewrites them into structured instructions, files, expected behavior, environments, and tests; repairs failed environments; removes hints; applies unified tests; and favors harder variants using reference-solver pass rates and repair counts.

Cowork pipelines preserve artifact-specific contracts. Search tasks carry evidence specifications and accept only grounded answers, with rubric judges for open reports. Office tasks combine seeded and hierarchically synthesized scenarios with real supporting documents and multi-axis rubrics, followed by cleanup for fabricated facts or references. Financial tasks are reverse-derived from real tool traces; spreadsheet tasks walk workbooks and compare recalculated cell values with reference workbooks. Slide tasks use source documents or real decks, varied instructions and teachers, then layer execution, agent, layout-rule, and rendered-image scoring. Reasoning data scales queries and multiple solution paths while cleaning ambiguous prompts, testing verifier edge cases, cross-checking model disagreements, and rubric-scoring traces.

SFT uses rejection sampling against domain-specific rewards plus multi-stage cleaning to retain interleaved thinking/action/observation trajectories across chat, reasoning, code, and cowork. RL adapts CISPO with episode-level reward-to-go and a trajectory baseline. Composite rewards combine task performance, dense process feedback (including penalties for language mixing and malformed tool calls), and relative completion-time shaping. Mixed-domain stages jointly sample reasoning, coding, agent, and general tasks while changing domain ratios, context lengths, and difficulty. Exact coefficients, sampling ratios, rollout counts, thresholds, and budgets are not disclosed.

SWE 流水线从公开且采用宽松许可证的 GitHub 仓库中收集已合并 PR 及关联 issue。规则过滤要求存在相关测试；智能体迭代构建多语言 Docker 环境；PR 按任务类型标记；奖励分别实现为失败转通过/保持通过测试、新功能测试或性能检查。模型验证用于修复描述不充分的问题。增强方式包括注入缺陷、合并提交、把修复任务反转为 SWE-Test，以及近似可验证的代码审查任务。每个保留实例由问题描述、基于测试的奖励和可运行 Docker 环境组成。

AppDev 使用专家编写的元查询与评分规范，再由 Agent-as-a-Verifier 在沙箱中按执行、交互和美学标准进行拒绝采样。Terminal-Gym 从社区讨论中筛选可脚本化、兼容 Linux/Docker 且可验证的任务，重写为包含指令、文件、预期行为、环境和测试的结构化对象；环境失败时迭代修复，再删除提示、运行统一测试，并依据参考求解器通过率和环境修复次数偏向更难变体。

Cowork 各流水线保留产物专用契约。搜索任务附带证据规范，只接收有实际检索证据支撑的答案；开放式报告则用 rubric 评审。办公任务结合基准种子和分层合成情境，配套真实支持文档及多轴 rubric，并清除捏造事实或引用的轨迹。金融任务从真实工具轨迹反向推导；电子表格任务遍历工作簿，并把外部引擎重算后的单元格值与参考工作簿比较。幻灯片任务从源文档或真实 deck 出发，变化指令与教师，并叠加执行、智能体、版式规则和渲染图像评分。推理数据同时扩展问题和多条解法，通过歧义问题清洗、验证器边界案例测试、模型分歧交叉检查和轨迹 rubric 评分保证质量。

SFT 对领域专用奖励做大规模拒绝采样并多阶段清洗，保留覆盖对话、推理、代码和 cowork 的思考—动作—观察交错轨迹。RL 改造 CISPO，采用 episode 级 reward-to-go 与轨迹基线。复合奖励组合任务表现、稠密过程反馈（包括语言混杂和工具调用格式错误惩罚）及相对完成时间塑形。混合领域训练在每阶段同时采样推理、代码、智能体和通用任务，并逐步调整领域比例、上下文长度与难度。具体系数、采样比例、rollout 数、阈值和预算均未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The report presents within-series gains from M2 to M2.5 and M2.7 across agentic coding, cowork, and reasoning evaluations, plus architecture and mechanism ablations. These support the claim that the combined model, data, agent scaffold, and RL system improved, but they do not isolate the quality contribution of any one corpus. Benchmark scores therefore should not be treated as item-level data validation.

Stronger evidence comes from explicit acceptance procedures: golden patches must satisfy task-specific tests; generated environments are executed and repaired; search trajectories must cite retrieved evidence; spreadsheet formulas are recalculated externally; and slide artifacts are rendered before visual scoring. The report also describes verifier edge-case analysis and cross-model disagreement checks for reasoning data. However, it publishes no corpus samples, acceptance rates, held-out verifier audits, reward-confusion matrices, or per-stage data ablations. The official repository and model page release model artifacts and deployment guidance, not Forge, the training workspaces, reward services, or trajectory datasets.

报告给出 M2、M2.5 到 M2.7 在智能体代码、cowork 与推理评测上的系列内提升，以及架构和机制消融。这些结果可以支持“模型、数据、智能体脚手架和 RL 系统的组合有所改进”，但无法分离任一语料库的质量贡献，因此基准分数不能视为逐样本数据验证。

更强的证据来自明确的验收程序：golden patch 必须通过任务专用测试；生成环境需要真实执行并修复；搜索轨迹必须引用实际检索证据；电子表格公式由外部引擎重算；幻灯片在视觉评分前必须渲染。报告还描述了推理数据的验证器边界案例分析和跨模型分歧检查。然而，语料样本、接受率、独立验证器审计、奖励混淆矩阵及逐阶段数据消融均未公开。官方仓库和模型页发布的是模型产物与部署说明，并不包含 Forge、训练工作区、奖励服务或轨迹数据集。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The notable contribution is an end-to-end agent-data contract that binds task synthesis, executable workspace construction, trajectory generation, and artifact-specific acceptance. Rather than reducing all agent outputs to textual preference scores, the pipelines use native evidence where possible: tests, runtime state, retrieved sources, recalculated workbook values, or rendered slides. The report also introduces variation across teacher models and agent scaffolds instead of relying on one fixed trajectory source.

Forge complements this contract by placing the policy/environment boundary at the generation interface and decoupling agent rollout, storage, inference, and training. Windowed-FIFO scheduling handles heterogeneous episode duration, while prefix-tree merging and inference optimization target repeated prefixes and rollout cost. None of these ingredients alone is entirely new; the contribution is their coordinated use at long context and across many artifact types. The report’s M2.7 self-evolution case is an operational demonstration, not a released self-improving data system.

较突出的贡献是一套端到端智能体数据契约，把任务合成、可执行工作区构建、轨迹生成和产物专用验收绑定起来。流水线并非把所有智能体输出都压缩为文本偏好分，而是在可能时使用原生证据：测试、运行时状态、检索来源、重算后的工作簿值或渲染后的幻灯片。报告还引入不同教师模型与智能体脚手架，而不是依赖单一固定轨迹来源。

Forge 通过把策略—环境边界设在模型生成接口处，并解耦智能体 rollout、存储、推理和训练来配合该契约。窗口化 FIFO 调度处理 episode 时长差异，前缀树合并和推理优化则降低重复前缀与 rollout 成本。这些组成技术并非全部新创，贡献在于它们在长上下文和多种产物类型上的协同使用。报告中的 M2.7 自进化案例只是运行展示，并不是已发布的自改进数据系统。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report is detailed about pipeline logic but sparse about inventory. Dataset sizes, exact source lists, collection dates, deduplication rules, language/geography distribution, teacher identities and versions, prompt templates, number of candidates per task, acceptance yields, human-review rates, and trajectory schemas are unknown. Although the SWE source is restricted to public repositories with permissive licenses, rights and privacy treatment for community posts, web pages, occupational data, office documents, financial material, workbooks, decks, and product-feedback signals are not comprehensively enumerated.

Artifact-aligned rewards reduce but do not remove reward error. Tests may be incomplete; model-enriched specifications can alter intent; LLM-generated tests can share blind spots with generators; pairwise and rubric judges remain subjective; visual scorers may reward presentation over factual content; and completion-time shaping can conflict with robust investigation. The paper provides no independent false-accept/false-reject estimates or reward weights. Dense rewards for “well-structured reasoning” also risk imposing stylistic proxies.

Reproducibility is limited because training data, Docker images, teachers, reward code, Forge, data pool, and acceptance logs are not released. The model page uses a modified-MIT label and the repository links a license, but those terms do not automatically cover source data or generated workspaces. Reported benchmark improvements are confounded by checkpoint, data, scaffold, infrastructure, and inference changes.

报告对流水线逻辑披露较细，但对数据清单披露很少。数据规模、精确来源、采集日期、去重规则、语言与地域分布、教师身份和版本、提示模板、每任务候选数、接受率、人工复核比例及轨迹模式均未知。虽然 SWE 来源限定为采用宽松许可证的公开仓库，但社区帖子、网页、职业数据库、办公文档、金融材料、工作簿、幻灯片和产品反馈信号的权利与隐私处理并未完整列举。

产物对齐奖励可以降低但不能消除奖励错误。测试可能不完整；模型补全任务说明可能改变原意；LLM 生成测试可能与生成器共享盲点；两两比较和 rubric 评审仍具主观性；视觉评分可能偏好外观而非事实；完成时间塑形也可能与稳健调查冲突。报告没有给出独立的误接受/误拒绝估计或奖励权重。对“结构良好推理”的稠密奖励还可能把文风当作质量代理。

复现性受限，因为训练数据、Docker 镜像、教师模型、奖励代码、Forge、数据池和验收日志均未发布。模型页标记为 modified-MIT，仓库也链接许可证，但这些条款不会自动覆盖源数据或生成工作区。报告中的基准提升同时受检查点、数据、脚手架、基础设施和推理设置变化影响。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This report is a useful blueprint for building auditable agent-training data. It shows how to define the episode object, draw the environment boundary, select a verifier that matches the deliverable, and retain executable evidence. The SWE, Terminal-Gym, search, spreadsheet, and slide pipelines offer concrete patterns for turning noisy real-world sources into tasks with workspaces and success predicates. Its distinction between deterministic verification, agent/rubric judging, and multi-signal acceptance is especially useful for risk-tiering data.

It is not a reusable dataset release. Practitioners can borrow the contract and audit checklist, but cannot reconstruct the reported mixture or training run from public artifacts. Any downstream Card or survey should keep M2, M2.5, and M2.7 evidence separate where relevant and avoid using benchmark leadership as a substitute for corpus documentation.

这份报告适合用作构建可审计智能体训练数据的蓝图。它展示了如何定义 episode 对象、划定环境边界、选择与交付物匹配的验证器，并保留可执行证据。SWE、Terminal-Gym、搜索、电子表格和幻灯片流水线提供了具体模式，可把嘈杂真实来源转化为带工作区和成功谓词的任务。它对确定性验证、智能体/rubric 评审及多信号验收的区分，尤其适合用于数据风险分层。

但它并不是可复用数据集发布。实践者可以借鉴契约和审计清单，却无法仅凭公开产物重建报告中的数据混合或训练过程。后续卡片或综述在必要时应区分 M2、M2.5 和 M2.7 的证据，不能以基准领先替代语料文档。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 4 as a set of different data contracts, not one homogeneous “agent dataset”; each domain has distinct sources, artifacts, and acceptance signals.
  • For SWE and Terminal-Gym, trace the full chain from noisy source through environment synthesis to executable tests; environment validity is part of the label.
  • Separate deterministic rewards (tests, values, tool evidence) from model, rubric, agent, and visual judgments; the latter require calibration that is not disclosed.
  • Read Sections 5–6 together: SFT retains interleaved trajectories by rejection sampling, while RL assigns episode-level credit with process and time shaping.
  • Treat Section 8 as model evaluation only. It does not report corpus counts, verifier error rates, or a controlled data-quality ablation.

• 把第 4 节理解为多套不同的数据契约，而不是一个同质“智能体数据集”；每个领域都有不同来源、产物和验收信号。
  • 对 SWE 与 Terminal-Gym，应从嘈杂来源一路追踪到环境合成和可执行测试；环境有效性本身就是标签的一部分。
  • 区分确定性奖励（测试、数值、工具证据）与模型、rubric、智能体和视觉评审；后者需要报告中未披露的校准。
  • 联读第 5–6 节：SFT 通过拒绝采样保留交错轨迹，RL 则用过程奖励和时间塑形在 episode 级分配信用。
  • 第 8 节只能视为模型评测，不能替代语料规模、验证器误差或受控数据质量消融。
